fragments.text: On April 13, 2026, Amazon entered into a definitive merger agreement to acquire Globalstar, Inc. (“Globalstar”), a Delaware corporation, for a mix of cash and stock consideration.
As of the date of the merger agreement, the acquisition implied a value for Globalstar of approximately $ 10.9 billion, including its debt.

new_facts.why_it_matters: A pending cash-and-stock acquisition that is a claim on liquidity and is not reflected in the commitments table totals.

new_facts.topic: New debt capacity and post-quarter issuance

fragments.text: In June 2026, we entered into a $ 17.5 billion unsecured delayed draw term loan with a syndicate of lenders (“Term Loan”), which matures three years from the date of borrowing and bears interest at the SOFR specified in the Term Loan plus a margin ranging from 0.625 % to 0.875 % based on our credit ratings.

Subsequent to June 30, 2026, we issued $ 25.0 billion of U.S. Dollar-denominated Notes for general corporate purposes with maturities between 2029 and 2066, including $ 750 million of floating rate Notes due in 2029 based on the compounded SOFR plus 0.58 %.

new_facts.why_it_matters: Undrawn term-loan capacity plus a large post-quarter bond issuance funds AI infrastructure spend beyond the balance-sheet date.
